basic_info.description: Comfort, quiet, security, and an outstanding location mere steps to Polk Street and multiple public transit lines are enjoyed by the residents in the Arundel, a modern concrete & steel doorman elevator building. The best of city life awaits with Michelin-starred restaurants, wine & coffee shops, hardware stores, fitness studios, and a newly opened BI-RITE market at your disposal. This south-facing condo enjoys sunshine and pretty evergreen treetop outlooks through double-pane windows. The recently remodeled kitchen with stainless appliances has bar seating to the dining and living rooms, and there is a huge living room window seat for reading or lounging. Floors throughout are wide plank wood, while both bathrooms are newly remodeled with decorator tile and large shower stalls. The primary suite has dual closet systems, while the 2nd bedroom has a wall-to-wall closet system. The building is surprisingly quiet, and the rear-facing primary bedroom is a sanctuary. Convenient in-unit stacking laundry. Building amenities include a rooftop deck with panoramic views to enjoy holiday fireworks or the Blue Angels, and a rear common garden. HOA dues include doorman, elevator, earthquake insurance, parking (+ guest parking), storage, DIRECTV. 99 WalkScore: Walker's Paradise.
